comparison_domain: Rishiganga hydropower project (~15 km downstream of the Ronti Peak source) and Tapovan-Vishnugad (upstream and downstream of the project intake)
x_preview_framing: Chamoli 2021 was a rock-and-ice avalanche that transformed into a debris flow and downstream flood -- it was NOT a glacial lake outburst or a dam-breach flood (docs/events/chamoli_2021.md line 8). This is a mass-flow EVENT comparison, shown to illustrate what workstream 8 (historical validation) would look like once built; it is not, and cannot become, a dam-breach validation for this event.

event_type.value: Rock-and-ice avalanche from Ronti Peak, transformed into a debris flow and downstream flood

material_composition.value: approximately 80% rock, 20% glacier ice by volume

rishiganga_frontal_speed_ms.basis: observed, ~15 km downstream of source, docs/events/chamoli_2021.md line 15-16

tapovan_upstream_frontal_speed_ms.basis: observed, just upstream of the project, docs/events/chamoli_2021.md line 18

tapovan_downstream_frontal_speed_ms.basis: observed, below the project, docs/events/chamoli_2021.md line 18-19

tapovan_downstream_mean_discharge_m3s.basis: observed, poorer model agreement reported near the project, docs/events/chamoli_2021.md line 19-20

debris_blockage_height_m.basis: observed, near the Ronti Gad confluence, docs/events/chamoli_2021.md line 21

landslide_lake_length_m.basis: observed, formed behind the debris blockage, docs/events/chamoli_2021.md line 21-22

total_deposit_volume_m3.basis: observed, at and just downstream of the confluence, docs/events/chamoli_2021.md line 22

predicted.method: illustrative clear-water dam-breach-style emulator prediction, approximated as if the avalanche were a breach hydrograph -- a mismatch the mass_flow_approximation caveat exists for

rishiganga_frontal_speed_relative_error_.note: (predicted - observed) / observed x 100, both illustrative-vs-real; not a real skill score

rishiganga_discharge_relative_error_pct.note: computed against the observed midpoint (8200-14200 m3/s)

tapovan_discharge_relative_error_pct.note: computed against the observed midpoint (2900-4900 m3/s)

provenance.note: Every observed.* value is real, from src_042 (Shugar et al. 2021, Science 373, eabh4455) as summarized in docs/events/chamoli_2021.md, with the exact supporting line cited in each field's basis/note. No observed value here is estimated or guessed -- anything the doc doesn't state (e.g. a gridded observed depth/arrival raster) is simply absent from this fixture, not filled in. The predicted.* side and every metrics.* value are entirely illustrative: there is no real Chamoli/Rishi Ganga simulation in this repo (docs/events/chamoli_2021.md 'Still needed before an M3/M5 campaign' lists exactly what is missing -- a sourced DEM/domain, an approved event representation, and a validation target). predicted values are deliberately set BELOW observed (a clear-water model without debris-flow bulking would plausibly underestimate a debris flow's speed/discharge), not copied from or fitted to the observed values, so the illustrative 'error' shown is a modelling argument, not a circular match.
